verdict.rationale: ADK offers lifecycle callbacks and plugins that hook into agent execution, plus a human-in-the-loop tool confirmation flow that can guard tool execution. These are plausible building blocks for guardrails, but the evidence describes callbacks only for logging, monitoring, and side-effects, not for validating or blocking content. Missing for 10: explicit input/output guardrail docs, evidence that callbacks can block or rewrite model inputs/outputs, built-in content-safety filters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
